values: 一名诡惑人心的恶魔，操纵敌人的欲望和自己的眷属来支配敌人。
A bewitching Hypogean Mage who manipulates her enemies' desire and overpowers them through her loyal minions.
你知道我很难满足的。呵呵……这就对了。
The ache of longing quench it.
I let you... get too close...
让我们随心所欲地狂欢吧。
Let's celebrate. Just you and me.
All I need is your love and desire.
Don't be shy I won't bite.
Are you going to stand me up again, Merlin?
嗯嗯……就是这样，我还想要更多哦。
More and I'll show you my appreciation...
哎呀，你还可以做得更好吧？
You need to try a little harder to impress me.
A thoughtless gift... How shall I punish you?
面对致命的欲望，人们总是明知故犯。
Humans always succumb to their darkest desires.
将纯白，染上欲望的颜色。
Stain this pure white canvas with the color of desire.
金玫瑰高定商店兑换获得。
I smell a whiff of desire here.
梅希拉是最危险的恶魔之一，鲜少有人能抵抗住她的诱惑。
Mehira is one of the most dangerous Hypogeans, as few can resist her temptations.
梅希拉的甜言蜜语皆是出于真心，正如她坚信人们会为她献出一切。
Her sweet words are spoken with genuine conviction, for she truly believes that people would surrender everything to her.
梅希拉不明白人们为何会对她充满敌意：她能提供梦寐以求的极致体验，这不好吗？
Mehira doesn't understand the hostility toward her. After all, isn't it a good thing that she can provide them with the unforgettable experience they have always desired?
那些被梅希拉吻过的人，光芒渐散的眼中往往还残留着对她的痴迷。
In the glassy eyes of those kissed by Mehira, their lingering infatuation with her remains.
梅希拉的每一只眷属都有名字，它们都来自她曾诱惑过的人，会为梅希拉奉献生命——但梅希拉从来不会缺少新的眷属。
All of Mehira's minions are smitten and willing to sacrifice their lives for her, yet she never lacks new followers.
在梅希拉精妙的幻象中，人们会将她认成自己最想见到的人，不自觉地向她走去。
Her victims are drawn to her, seeing her as their loved ones within her intricate illusions.
传说梅希拉的亲吻可以融化世间万物，同为恶魔的蒂斯妮娅对此不置可否——至少她的寒冰不会。
Legend has it that Mehira's kisses can melt everything in the world. However, Cryonaia, also a Hypogean, is confident that her ice would stay intact.
梅希拉喜欢一种紫黑色的花，因其外形像是倒挂的丧钟，甜美多汁的浆果只需两颗就能让人毙命，是她最爱的零食。
Mehira is fond of a purplish-black flower for its resemblance to an upside-down death knell. Its sweet, juicy berries are lethal, yet they are Mehira's favorite snack.
“纯粹的欢愉在我心中绽放，她就是梦想本身，她就是我的唯一真爱……”——某位圣堂神父临终前为梅希拉所写的“赞歌”，此人已因堕落而被圣堂制裁。
"Pure joy blossoms in my heart. She is my dream, my only true love..." A corrupted priest wrote this for Mehira before he was executed by the temple.
据传，为了弄清梅林为何不受她的诱惑，梅希拉曾在某次无法查证的恶魔聚会上表示，她愿意给梅林当三百年仆人，以换取其中的奥秘。
To uncover why Merlin is immune to her temptations, Mehira once declared her willingness to serve Merlin for three hundred years at an unverified Hypogean gathering.
可惜，何等可惜！只差一厘，你就是完美的形态！
Alas, how regrettable. You're just a hair's breath from being perfect.
I smell a whiff of desire here.
